name: Cybersecurity
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

beginner.summary: For IT staff and graduates starting in security. Covers security principles, threats and attacks, networking and operating system security, cryptography, identity and access, web application risks, vulnerability scanning, logging and SIEM basics, incident response, policies and compliance, and Security+ preparation, all in an isolated practice lab.
prerequisites: Basic IT knowledge: files, networks, users and passwords
Comfortable with Windows and a command line
A laptop able to run virtual machines
outcomes: Explain security principles, common threats and defences
Secure Windows and Linux systems and networks at a basic level
Find vulnerabilities and read security logs
Follow an incident response process and prepare for Security+

subtopics: Why cybersecurity matters to every organisation
Types of attackers and their motives
Laws and ethics: only test what you are allowed to test
Building an isolated lab with VirtualBox
Kali Linux and a vulnerable target machine
days.lab_task: Build an isolated lab with Kali Linux and a deliberately vulnerable machine on a host-only network, take snapshots and confirm the lab cannot reach the internet or the home network.
days.deliverable: Lab diagram, network settings and connectivity test results
checks: Reply received on the host-only network
Ping an internet address from the target
Machine returns to the saved state
objectives: Work within legal and ethical limits

days.lab_task: Analyse ten sample emails and messages, mark each as phishing or genuine with the clues, and map three real breaches to the attack types used.
days.deliverable: Email analysis and breach mapping
checks: At least nine correct with clues listed
Attack types and entry points named

days.lab_task: Capture traffic in the lab, identify DNS, HTTP and TCP handshakes, find a plain-text password in a captured login and explain why encryption matters.
days.deliverable: Annotated packet capture and findings
checks: Password found in the HTTP traffic

subtopics: Why defenders scan their own networks
Rules for scanning only authorised systems
days.lab_task: Scan the lab network with Nmap to list live hosts, open ports, services and versions, and write a short report of exposed services on the target.
days.deliverable: Scan output and exposure report
checks: Each exposed service has a risk note

days.lab_task: Harden a Windows VM with a checklist: remove an admin account, enable the firewall and Defender, set password and lockout policy, enable BitLocker and find failed logons in Event Viewer.
days.deliverable: Hardening checklist with evidence

days.lab_task: Harden a Linux server: disable root SSH login, use key-based SSH, set a firewall, remove an unused service and find failed SSH attempts in the logs.
days.deliverable: Hardening checklist with evidence
checks: Entries found in the auth log

subtopics: Encryption at rest and in transit
days.lab_task: Encrypt and decrypt a file with AES and RSA, compare file hashes, create a self-signed certificate and inspect a website's TLS certificate chain.
days.deliverable: Commands, outputs and explanations
checks: Change one byte in a file
Root, intermediate and leaf certificates identified

days.lab_task: Set up users and roles in an identity provider, enforce MFA, apply least privilege to three roles and run a leaver process that removes all access.
days.deliverable: Identity configuration and leaver checklist
checks: Log in without the second factor
No role has more than it needs

days.topic: Web Application Security and the OWASP Top 10
days.lab_task: In the lab, find and demonstrate SQL injection, cross-site scripting and broken access control in a deliberately vulnerable app, and write the fix for each.
days.deliverable: Findings with evidence and fixes
checks: Script runs in another user's view
Each fix addresses the root cause

days.lab_task: Scan the lab target with a vulnerability scanner, prioritise the top five findings by risk, fix two and rescan to confirm.
days.deliverable: Scan report, prioritised list and rescan evidence
checks: Order justified by risk and exposure

days.lab_task: Set up pfSense to segment the lab into user and server zones, write firewall rules, enable Suricata and trigger an alert with a port scan.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, rules and IDS alert
checks: Reach the server zone from users on a blocked port
Specific allow rules before the default deny

days.topic: Logging, Monitoring and a First SIEM
days.lab_task: Send Windows and Linux logs to a SIEM, search for failed logons, build a dashboard and create an alert for five failed logons in one minute.
days.deliverable: SIEM searches, dashboard and alert rule
checks: Logons, failures and top sources shown
objectives: Search and alert in a SIEM

days.lab_task: Test antivirus with the EICAR file, block an unapproved application with allow listing, and restore files from backup after a simulated ransomware encryption.
days.deliverable: Test results and recovery evidence

days.topic: Incident Response: Detect, Contain and Recover
days.lab_task: Respond to a simulated account compromise: detect it in the SIEM, contain the account, collect evidence, recover and write an incident report.
days.deliverable: Incident timeline and report
checks: Suspicious logon found in the SIEM
objectives: Follow the incident response life cycle

days.lab_task: Create a storage bucket with public access by mistake, find it with a posture tool, fix it, restrict a security group and enable cloud audit logging.
days.deliverable: Findings before and after and configuration evidence

subtopics: Data protection laws: DPDP Act and GDPR
days.lab_task: Write an acceptable use policy, run a risk assessment for five assets and map existing controls to NIST CSF functions.
days.deliverable: Policy, risk register and control mapping
checks: Likelihood, impact and treatment for each risk
Each function has at least one control

days.lab_task: Write a Python script that parses an auth log and lists IPs with more than ten failed logins, and a PowerShell script that lists local administrators on a Windows host.
days.deliverable: Two scripts and their output
checks: Run the Python script on the sample log

days.lab_task: Run a phishing simulation in the lab with GoPhish against test accounts, measure click and report rates, and design a short awareness session from the results.
days.deliverable: Simulation results and awareness session plan

days.lab_task: Take a 90-question timed practice exam with performance-based items, analyse results by domain and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, domain analysis and study plan

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Securing a Small Office Network
days.lab_task: Assess a small office lab network, harden its Windows and Linux machines, segment it with firewall rules, centralise logs with alerts, respond to a simulated attack and present a security report.
days.deliverable: Assessment, hardening evidence, SIEM alerts, incident report and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Alert fires and the incident is contained
Risks, fixes and next steps clear
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one engagement

intermediate.summary: For security analysts and engineers. Covers SOC operations, detection engineering with SIEM and MITRE ATT&CK, network and endpoint detection, threat intelligence, vulnerability management programmes, penetration testing of networks, web apps and Active Directory, cloud security, digital forensics, malware analysis, DevSecOps and security frameworks.
prerequisites: Knows networking, Windows and Linux security and basic SIEM use
Comfortable with scripting in Python or PowerShell
outcomes: Run SOC operations and build detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
Test networks, web applications and Active Directory in authorised labs
Investigate incidents with forensics and malware analysis
Build vulnerability management and DevSecOps programmes

days.lab_task: Work a simulated SOC shift: triage 25 alerts with playbooks, open cases for real threats, close false positives with reasons and hand over to the next shift.
days.deliverable: Triage log, cases and handover note
checks: True and false positives match the answer key in at least 22
Each case has evidence and next steps

days.topic: Detection Engineering with SIEM and MITRE ATT&CK
subtopics: Testing detections with Atomic Red Team
days.lab_task: Write five detections for credential dumping, persistence and lateral movement, test them with Atomic Red Team, tune them and show coverage in ATT&CK Navigator.
days.deliverable: Detection rules, test results and coverage map
checks: False positives reduced with no missed true alerts

days.lab_task: Build a profile of one threat actor targeting your sector, load its indicators into MISP, enrich SIEM alerts with them and write a one-page intelligence brief.
days.deliverable: Actor profile, MISP event and intelligence brief

subtopics: Full packet capture versus flow data
days.lab_task: Analyse a provided packet capture of an infected host with Zeek and Wireshark, find the command-and-control traffic and write a Suricata rule to detect it.
days.deliverable: Analysis notes and Suricata rule

tools: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or Wazuh
days.lab_task: Deploy Sysmon and an EDR agent, run simulated attacker actions, investigate the process tree, isolate the host and write the investigation summary.
days.deliverable: Telemetry evidence, investigation summary and isolation record
checks: Decoded command and parent process found
Host loses network access except to the EDR console

subtopics: Risk-based prioritisation with CVSS, EPSS and KEV
days.lab_task: Design a vulnerability management process for 500 assets, prioritise a provided scan of 2,000 findings with EPSS and the KEV catalogue and report SLA compliance.
days.deliverable: Process design, prioritised list and SLA report
checks: Known exploited findings at the top

days.lab_task: Under written rules of engagement for the lab, test a vulnerable host from reconnaissance to privilege escalation and write a findings report with risk ratings and fixes.
days.deliverable: Rules of engagement, test notes and findings report
checks: Shell obtained on the lab target
Each finding has evidence, risk and fix

days.lab_task: Test a deliberately vulnerable web app and its API with Burp Suite, find at least six vulnerabilities including an IDOR and SSRF and report them with reproduction steps.
days.deliverable: Findings report with reproduction steps
checks: Another user's data accessed by changing an ID
Internal resource reached through the app
Another tester can repeat each finding

days.lab_task: In a lab domain, find an attack path to Domain Admin with BloodHound, demonstrate Kerberoasting, then fix the path with tiering and LAPS and detect the attack in the SIEM.
days.deliverable: Attack path, fixes and detection evidence
checks: SIEM alert on the ticket requests

days.topic: Cloud Security in AWS and Azure
subtopics: Security services: GuardDuty and Defender for Cloud
days.lab_task: Audit a deliberately misconfigured cloud account with Prowler or ScoutSuite, fix the top five issues, enable threat detection and investigate a simulated credential leak.
days.deliverable: Audit report, fixes and investigation notes
checks: Actions taken with the key traced in logs

subtopics: Memory capture and analysis with Volatility
Windows artefacts: prefetch, registry, event logs
days.lab_task: Investigate a provided memory image and disk image from a compromised machine, build a timeline of attacker activity and write a forensic report.
days.deliverable: Timeline and forensic report
checks: Malicious process and network connection found
Entry, persistence and actions in order

days.topic: Malware Analysis: Static and Dynamic Techniques
subtopics: Static analysis: hashes, strings, PE headers
days.lab_task: Analyse a provided malware sample in an isolated VM with static and dynamic methods, extract indicators and write a YARA rule that detects it.
days.deliverable: Analysis report, indicators and YARA rule
checks: File hashes, domains and registry keys listed
Matches the sample and not clean files
Analysis VM had no network path out

days.topic: Identity Security and Privileged Access Management
days.lab_task: Configure conditional access and phishing-resistant MFA, set up just-in-time admin access and run an access review that removes stale privileges.
days.deliverable: Policies, PAM configuration and review results
checks: Sign in from a blocked location
Granted for a limited time with approval

days.lab_task: Threat-model a small web app with STRIDE and add static analysis, dependency, secrets and image scanning and a ZAP scan to its pipeline with sensible gates.
days.deliverable: Threat model and pipeline with security gates

days.lab_task: Analyse five reported phishing emails from their headers, URLs and attachments, check the domain's SPF, DKIM and DMARC records and automate removal of a phish from mailboxes.
days.deliverable: Analysis notes, DNS record review and automation evidence
checks: Phish removed from all test mailboxes

days.topic: Security Automation with Python and SOAR
days.lab_task: Build a playbook that enriches suspicious-IP alerts with intelligence, blocks the IP after analyst approval and records every step, and measure time saved.
days.deliverable: Playbook, scripts and time comparison

days.topic: Security Frameworks and Risk Management in Practice
days.lab_task: Assess an organisation against CIS Controls, map gaps to ISO 27001 Annex A, build a risk register and present a prioritised improvement plan.
days.deliverable: Assessment, gap mapping, risk register and plan

days.lab_task: Write a ransomware playbook and run a tabletop exercise with roles for IT, legal, communications and leadership, then record improvements.
days.deliverable: Playbook, exercise record and improvements
checks: Steps, roles and decision points defined
Each role makes its decisions on time

days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for CySA+ and CEH, analyse results by domain and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, analysis and study plan

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: SOC Detection and Response Engagement
days.lab_task: Build detections for a lab company, run a multi-stage attack simulation, detect and investigate it with SIEM, EDR and forensics, respond with a playbook and present the incident report.
days.deliverable: Detection set, investigation timeline, incident report and a 15-minute presentation
checks: Each stage detected or the gap recorded
Attack stages in order with evidence
Root cause, impact and fixes clear
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one engagement
Detect and respond to a full attack

advanced.summary: For senior analysts, security engineers, architects and security leaders. Covers threat hunting, red, blue and purple teaming, advanced Active Directory and cloud attacks and defences, container and Kubernetes security, zero trust, security architecture, detection as code, advanced forensics and reverse engineering, OT and AI security, application security programmes and security leadership.
prerequisites: Has worked in security operations, testing or engineering
Knows ATT&CK, SIEM, EDR and penetration testing
Scripts confidently in Python or PowerShell
outcomes: Design zero trust and secure architectures
Lead advanced investigations and security programmes
Govern security risk and report to boards

subtopics: Hunting queries in KQL and SPL
days.lab_task: Run three hypothesis-driven hunts across a month of lab telemetry for persistence, lateral movement and data staging, document findings and convert one into a detection.
days.deliverable: Hunt reports and new detection
checks: Convert a hunt into a detection
Detection fires on the planted activity

days.lab_task: Plan and run an authorised emulation of a named threat actor's techniques in the lab with Caldera, reach the agreed objective and record which steps were detected.
days.deliverable: Emulation plan, operation log and detection gap report
checks: Agreed objective achieved in the lab

days.lab_task: Run a purple team exercise for 15 techniques, score detection coverage before and after joint fixes and set up regular regression testing.
days.deliverable: Coverage scores, fixes and regression schedule
checks: Detected, logged and missed recorded per technique

days.topic: Advanced Active Directory and Entra ID Attacks and Defences
days.lab_task: Demonstrate a certificate services abuse path and a DCSync in a lab domain, detect both, harden Tier 0 and rehearse recovery after a golden ticket.
days.deliverable: Attack evidence, detections, hardening and recovery plan
checks: KRBTGT reset twice and tickets invalidated

days.lab_task: Emulate cloud attacks with Stratus Red Team, detect them, investigate one end to end and apply organisation-wide guardrails that prevent it.
days.deliverable: Detections, investigation and guardrails
checks: Each detected or the gap recorded

days.lab_task: Attack a misconfigured cluster in the lab to escape a privileged pod, then fix it with pod security, RBAC, network policies and signed images, and detect the attack with Falco.
days.deliverable: Attack evidence, fixes and Falco alerts
checks: Deploy the same pod after fixes

days.lab_task: Assess a provided organisation against a zero trust maturity model, design the target architecture and build a three-year migration roadmap.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, architecture and roadmap

tools: Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool or OWASP Threat Dragon
days.lab_task: Run a security design review of a new payments platform with a system-level threat model, security requirements and decision records, and present the findings.
days.deliverable: Threat model, requirements, decision records and review report
checks: Threats and mitigations for each component

days.topic: Detection as Code and Security Data Engineering
days.lab_task: Move detections into Git with tests in CI that replay sample events, deploy them to the SIEM from the pipeline and reduce log costs by filtering low-value data.
days.deliverable: Detection repository, pipeline and cost report
checks: Volume reduced without losing needed data

days.topic: Advanced Digital Forensics and Incident Response
days.lab_task: Investigate a simulated ransomware attack across 20 hosts with Velociraptor, build a super-timeline in Timesketch, find patient zero and the exfiltration path.
days.deliverable: Investigation timeline, findings and expert report
checks: First infected host and entry point identified

days.lab_task: Reverse engineer a provided sample in an isolated lab, unpack it, extract its configuration and command-and-control addresses, and write detections from the findings.
days.deliverable: Analysis report, extracted configuration and detections

days.lab_task: Analyse traffic from a simulated plant, spot an unauthorised Modbus write, design segmentation using the Purdue model and write an OT-specific response playbook.
days.deliverable: Traffic analysis, segmentation design and playbook

subtopics: Threats to AI and LLM applications
days.lab_task: Red-team a lab LLM assistant for prompt injection and data leakage, fix the top findings and write an AI security policy for the organisation.
days.deliverable: Red-team report, fixes and AI security policy
checks: Covers data, access, testing and approval

subtopics: SAST, DAST and SCA at scale
Software bill of materials and supply chain
days.lab_task: Assess an organisation with OWASP SAMM, design an AppSec programme with champions and tooling, and set up SBOM tracking for three applications.
days.deliverable: SAMM assessment, programme design and SBOM tracking

days.topic: Third-Party and Software Supply Chain Risk
days.lab_task: Tier 20 suppliers by risk, assess the top three with evidence, add security clauses to a contract and run a response to a simulated breach at a software supplier.
days.deliverable: Supplier tiers, assessments, contract clauses and breach response record
checks: Tiers justified by data access and criticality
Findings and required actions for each
Affected systems found and actions taken within the plan's timings

days.topic: Security Leadership, Governance and Board Reporting
subtopics: Regulatory duties: CERT-In, DPDP Act, sector rules
days.lab_task: Write a three-year security strategy with budget and risk appetite for a provided company and present a quarterly board report on cyber risk.
days.deliverable: Strategy, budget and board report
checks: Clear risk position and decisions needed

days.topic: Crisis Management and Ransomware Response Leadership
days.lab_task: Lead a two-day simulated ransomware crisis with executives, legal, insurers and communications, make the key decisions and run the after-action review.
days.deliverable: Decision log, notifications and after-action report
checks: CERT-In and regulator deadlines met with correct content

subtopics: Encryption and key management at scale
days.lab_task: Discover and classify sensitive data across a lab environment, apply DLP policies, handle a data subject request and respond to a simulated privacy incident.
days.deliverable: Classification results, DLP policies and incident record

days.lab_task: Take a timed 125-question CISSP practice exam, analyse results by domain and write a study plan.
days.deliverable: Practice score, analysis and study plan

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Security Programme and Adversary Simulation
days.lab_task: Design a security programme and zero trust architecture for a lab enterprise, emulate a named adversary, hunt and respond, close detection gaps with a purple team and present the programme to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Strategy, architecture, emulation and response reports and a 20-minute board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
